summary.intent: Implement a batch of CLI hardening items (from a peer session auditing #638) for the callisto CLI: a shared terminal-aware page-size helper for paged prompts, E214 improvements, --dry-run in the add wizard, init validation/workflow-prompt changes, Summary normalisation, exit-code simplification, test updates, and docs; then run the full gate and commit locally without pushing.
summary.outcome: Code, tests, and docs changes for the batch were written across the callisto-cli crate and specs, the gate commands were run sequentially (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, audit) and a local commit was made. The transcript does not show the gate exit codes or commit sha output, so pass/fail results are unconfirmed here.

repo: Inquire redraws relative to the previous frame, so a list frame taller than the terminal puts the highlight and ticks on the wrong rows; page size must account for prompt and help wrap rows plus one spare row.
Prompts proof type tty::Prompts is now built via Prompts::detect (Option) with a cfg(test) for_tests constructor; init::run takes Option<tty::Prompts> instead of a bool.
CliError::NotATty now carries a Vec<&'static str> of missing flags; E214 help text lives in error.rs and is mirrored in docs/errors.md and docs/specs/cli.json (CLI-ADD-04).
Exit code decision in main.rs is now 'Cancelled -> 130 else match exit_kind', so ExitKind has no Cancelled mapping in error.rs.
Flag-only checks for init (product package, artifact targets, binary package presence, origin repo) were hoisted into requested_release() ahead of collect_answers.

PTY tests should wait on text drawn by the specific prompt (e.g. 'summary (Esc cancels)', 'the summary cannot be blank') rather than counting a prompt title plus sleeping, and avoid size-dependent assertions.
Project uses an rtk wrapper and just recipes (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, audit); work happens in a git worktree under .claude/worktrees/wp-add-inquire.
unicode-width 0.2 was added as a dependency of callisto-cli for label truncation.

code.finding: New ListKind, ListLayout, fit_list/fit_list_to and truncate helpers compute page size from (columns, rows) and truncate labels to width minus prefix (2 for Select, 6 for MultiSelect); fit_list_to is unit-testable with explicit sizes, avoiding a pty crate.
run_wizard/ask gained a dry_run parameter that skips the 'Write this changeset?' confirmation; Summary::new strips leading U+FEFF and converts CRLF to LF.
Workflow question is skipped when scaffold::ensure_workflow_absent fails (workflow already exists), using the same skip note as --yes.

workflow: Running independent gate commands in the background with a Monitor hung for 20 minutes; running `just pre-push` alone in the foreground finished quickly (likely a stale cargo lock earlier).
Batch edits via Python string replacement scripts were efficient but required follow-up fixes when replacements matched multiple or zero sites (e.g. repeated pty test edits).

friction: The first background `just pre-push && lint && doc-check` run hung and the Monitor expired after 20m with no events; the task had to be stopped and rerun.
Some Python string-replace edits needed to be reapplied or adjusted because patterns differed in indentation or occurred twice.
Gate exit codes and the final commit sha/signature status are not visible in the transcript output, so the required report to the peer cannot be fully assembled from it.
open_items: Three contract items (TERM=dumb, init context to stderr while prompting, re-ask on empty selection) are held until the peer confirms; the peer will message before commit if approved.
Report to the peer: commit sha, gate exit codes, and one line per item; do not push.
Items not visibly addressed in the transcript (e.g. item 8 cli.json:15 description for stdin and stderr, and the cli.rs:176 --package help wording) should be verified against the final diff.
